toegepas.voor: Jy kyk steeds met Graad 4 en 5 se woorde
toegepas.na: Jy gebruik steeds Graad 4 en 5 se woorde
toegepas.rede_vinder: One does not 'look with words' in Afrikaans; 'gebruik' says what is meant.
toegepas.fout: 'kyk met ... woorde' is not natural Afrikaans; one does not look with words.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jy gebruik steeds Graad 4 en 5 se woorde' says plainly what is meant without changing the content.

toegepas.voor: Stel jou 'n prent voor van 'n seun en sy hond wat net in blou geverf is.
toegepas.na: Stel jou 'n prent van 'n seun en sy hond voor. Die prent is net in blou geverf.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'wat' can be read as referring to the dog rather than the picture; splitting the sentence removes the ambiguity and puts the separable verb's 'voor' in its natural place.
toegepas.fout: 'wat net in blou geverf is' can attach to the dog rather than the picture, which makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Splitting the sentence removes the ambiguity in two short Grade 6 sentences, with the same picture and the same facts.

toegepas.voor: Die lug is ligblou en die hond is blou.
toegepas.na: Die lug is ligblou, en die hond is blou.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die lug is ligblou' and 'die hond is blou' are two full sentences, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

toegepas.blok: Hoe jy die dele uitmekaar hou
toegepas.voor: Jy hou hulle eerder uitmekaar deur ligter teenoor donkerder.
toegepas.na: Jy hou hulle eerder uitmekaar deur ligter en donkerder weergawes teenoor mekaar te stel.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'deur ligter teenoor donkerder' has no noun or verb and reads as a fragment; the lesson's own word 'weergawes' completes it without new content.
toegepas.fout: 'deur ligter teenoor donkerder' has no noun or verb and reads as a fragment.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal completes the construction with the lesson's own word 'weergawes' and adds no content.

toegepas.voor: Dit is nie regte gewig nie.
toegepas.na: Dit gaan nie oor regte gewig nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dit is nie regte gewig nie' is wooden; 'Dit gaan nie oor' is the natural Afrikaans way to say this.
toegepas.fout: 'Dit is nie regte gewig nie' is wooden; 'dit' has no clear referent.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit gaan nie oor regte gewig nie' is the natural Afrikaans phrasing and keeps the point that the heaviness is only how it looks.

toegepas.voor: laat hom minder swaar lyk as sy grootte
toegepas.na: laat hom minder swaar lyk as wat jy by sy grootte sou verwag
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence compares how heavy the horse looks with his size itself, which is illogical; the comparison is with what his size would lead you to expect.
toegepas.fout: The sentence compares how heavy the horse looks with his size itself, which is illogical.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal makes the comparison logical (with what his size leads you to expect) without adding any fact, and keeps 'lyk'.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Kry' in the sense of 'find' is colloquial; 'sien' is clearer and more natural here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Kry' in the sense of 'come across' (aantref) is standard, natural Afrikaans, so 'sien' is a lateral move.
